_comment: Systems of record the OT pilot's WS1 deployment (ot_ws1.py) resolves against.
monitoring_rounds: the sensors each daily round names (work_orders.json MON-ROUND
names them in prose only). work_order_targets: the loop, valve, alarm or work
order each signed work order names. Deployment-owned data for a simulated
plant; a real site reads these from its CMMS and historian.
